Its most prominent feature is a long, massive bill with a large, distensible gular pouch that appears reddish-orange and pinkish near the base. The eye is visible with a blue-ish tint. The background is a soft-focus light blue, suggesting water or sky. There is another pelican partially visible in the upper left background.
